design_notes: Use a single accent colour (e.g., IPO Watch's brand blue) for table headers and pull-quote rule.
Tables: serif body text, hairline rules between rows, bold header row with a thin rule below.
Pull-quote: set in a larger serif italic, with a hairline rule above and below, centred or left-aligned.
Sidebar: boxed with a thin border, background tint (light grey or accent colour at 10% opacity), serif text.
No icons, no decorative imagery, no stock photos.

pull_quotes.quote: For the period ended November 30, 2022, the top 10 clients accounted for 92.61% of sales, and the top 5 contributed more than 75%.
pull_quotes.rationale: Highlights the extreme customer concentration risk in a single, memorable fact.

sidebars.body_markdown: The issue size, breakdown between fresh issue and offer for sale, and price band are not disclosed in the available pages of the DRHP. The lead manager is Share India Capital Services Private Limited [^drhp-p42] and the registrar is Skyline Financial Services Private Limited [^drhp-p42]. Because the issue size is less than ₹10,000 lakh (₹100 crore), no independent monitoring agency will be appointed to oversee the deployment of funds [^drhp-p27].
sidebars.rationale: Summarises key offer details (or their absence) in a compact sidebar, freeing the main text from listing them.
sidebars.title: The offer at a glance
